description: Table-tennis evaluation runtime interface for the Unitree G1 (29 DoF, fixed pelvis) vs. a served ball, implemented by tt_sim.scene.TableTennisEnv / tt_sim.evaluate.

observations.name: robot.joint_position
observations.description: Current joint positions, ordered per extensions.robot.joint_order.

observations.name: robot.joint_velocity
observations.description: Current joint velocities, ordered per extensions.robot.joint_order.

observations.name: ball.position
observations.description: Ball centre-of-mass position (x, y, z) in the table-centred world frame: origin at table centre, x along the 2.74 m length (robot at x<0), y along the 1.525 m width, z up from the floor (table top at z=0.76 m).

observations.name: ball.velocity
observations.description: Ball linear velocity (vx, vy, vz) in the same world frame as ball.position.

observations.name: paddle.position
observations.description: World position of the paddle body (welded to right_wrist_yaw_link).

observations.name: paddle.quaternion
observations.description: World orientation of the paddle body as a unit quaternion, MuJoCo (w, x, y, z) convention.

actions.name: robot.desired_joint_position
actions.description: Desired joint positions for the vendor G1 position actuators (kp=500, dampratio=1), ordered per extensions.robot.joint_order.

robot.notes: Fixed-base variant of .him/contracts/runtime.json: identical joint_order/model/source, but the pelvis freejoint is removed (see tt_sim/scene.py module docstring) and this contract adds the ball/paddle observation signals tt_sim.scene.TableTennisEnv exposes for the table-tennis evaluation task. stateful=true (unlike runtime.json) because TableTennisEnv carries per-episode contact/event state across steps. UNCONFIRMED against HIM's server-side evaluator, same caveat as runtime.json: reconcile signal names/rate/joint order with HIM's actual G1 table-tennis fixture before relying on this for a real submission.

scene.note: ITTF facts as given for this task; assumed_restitution is this repo's calibrated MuJoCo contact-solver assumption, not a MuJoCo-native parameter (see tt_sim/scene.py BOUNCE_SOLREF/BOUNCE_SOLIMP comments).
